title: 從聊天到會做事：為什麼需要 agent？

bullets.text: 新的基礎模型能力，讓開發者有機會做出能替我們辦事的自主 agent。
bullets.quote: These new capabilities make it finally possible to develop autonomous, intelligent agents to act as our assistants, coworkers, and coaches.

bullets.text: Agent 由 LLM 自己決定流程與工具使用，不只是回答問題。
bullets.quote: Agents, on the other hand, are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, maintaining control over how they accomplish tasks.

bullets.text: 沒有外部工具也能算是 agent，但能力會受限。
bullets.quote: A system doesn’t need access to external tools to be an agent. However, without external tools, the agent’s capabilities would be limited.
